symptom: Chief Engineer produced a schema-valid portfolio, but completion-contract validation aborted before Director because a not_applicable lint verifier retained an untrusted command_authority_hash.

exact_run_evidence.error: invalid project completion contract: not_applicable verification must use command_authority_hash=null

root_cause: CE may advise verifier semantics but PM alone owns executable verifier commands and their hashes. The composer already canonicalized required verifier rows without PM authority to not_applicable, yet explicit not_applicable rows were validated before canonicalization. A provider-supplied hash and coverage therefore caused a false terminal CE failure even though no executable authority was being granted.
safety_boundary: Canonicalize only rows already declared not_applicable. Clear command, command_authority_hash, covers_obligation_ids, and owner_task_id. Required verifier rows still resolve exclusively through PM command authority and remain fail-closed on ambiguity or mismatch.

verification.tdd_red: The regression first failed on non-null hash, then exposed non-empty coverage as a second invariant violation.
verification.negative_authority_boundary: Required verifiers with unknown or ambiguous command authority remain rejected.

automatic_audit_rule: Before attributing a completion-contract failure to Director or model quality, inspect exact CE verification rows. A not_applicable row must carry no executable command, authority hash, covered obligation, or owner; canonicalize that zero-authority state before strict contract validation.

fresh_bench_verification.result: Chief Engineer completed and Director dispatched all three project tasks; the prior not_applicable command-authority terminal was absent.

next_action: Closed. Continue r19 at its Director-local quality boundary without restarting PM or Chief Engineer.
